title: AI price negotiation
floorHint: The engine takes the highest floor from the constraints you set. The minimum margin is kept after the highest processing fee among your payment methods, because the customer picks how to pay after the price is agreed. That number is never shown to customers or the AI.
notOnPlan: AI price negotiation is not included in this shop's plan.
allowCouponStacking: Allow coupon stacking on negotiated offers
optionsHint: An option switched off keeps its price fixed. The settings below apply to every option that negotiates.
optionFloorHint: Options priced differently can each have their own minimum selling price. Leave it empty to use the product's floor. Any discount or margin limit below still applies beside it.
optionsUnsaved: {count, plural, one {# new option negotiates once the product is saved, and can be switched off after that.} other {# new options negotiate once the product is saved, and can be switched off after that.}}
